newsitem.title: UK: Vickers shares drop after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: Vickers shares drop after profit warning.

text.p: Shares in Vickers Plc dropped sharply on Thursday after the armoured cars to Rolls-Royce cars group warned that its first-half results would not match last year's figures.
After being unchanged at 226p as the statement was released, the stock declined to be down 17-1/2p at 208-1/2 by 1109 GMT -- its lowest since July 1995.
In his statement to the company's annual general meeting, Vickers chairman Sir Richard Lloyd said export orders were proving harder to obtain and profit margins were tending to thin.
He said profit in the first three months of 1997 was below that in the first quarter of 1996.
